mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the pen carriage made the rover’s drawing purpose visible and connected the separate assembly to the deck.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second guard was clear but repetitive after fitting the first.

surprise.text: The spring surrounds one guide rod; its placement clarified how it relates to the carriage.

arbitrary.text: Choosing which guard to fit first felt arbitrary because either was offered and the goal did not distinguish them.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the drawing rover does, though this chapter was mostly straightforward guided fitting.
